1942Older than Independence, and still on the same lane in Kothapeta.

Three generations behind the counter

Grandmothers bought here, then their daughters, and now their granddaughters. The family still helps every customer choose.

  1. 1942 · The shop opens

    Started in Kothapeta, Guntur, selling cotton sarees to local families.

  2. Known for mul mul

    Soft mul mul cottons became the sarees people came back for, wash after wash.

  3. Wedding and function orders

    Families started ordering sarees in bulk to gift guests at weddings and functions.

  4. Today

    The next generation runs the shop, with the same quality and the same patient service.

The collection

Sarees for every guest at your wedding

Customers order sarees in bulk to gift relatives at weddings and functions. Tell us how many you need and your budget, and we’ll keep a selection ready.

Plan a bulk order
  1. Send the number of sarees and your budget per saree on WhatsApp.
  2. We share photos of matching sarees in your price range.
  3. Visit the shop to see them in person, or confirm on WhatsApp.
